cut: In src/library.rs, have the shared front-matter parser report through a callback so both loaders can use Checker::problem directly and drop the intermediate diagnostic vectors. In Checker::external, return after reporting invalid reference fields, then bind the fetched directory and parsed description directly. In src/upstream.rs, consolidate the fetch fallback and commit checks, and use tempdir_in for atomic staging. In src/project.rs, build the provenance string separately and reuse one generated-comment formatter for core, local and external skills.
answer: All made: check_skill_md reports through a callback into Checker::problem, no diagnostic vectors; external returns after the reference-field problems and binds dir and description directly; the fetch helper is inlined into tree as one closure with the two steps (staging already used tempdir_in); role_files has one generated-comment formatter taking the provenance suffix.
